from fastapi import FastAPI, Request, HTTPException, Depends
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer
from fastapi_csrf_protect import CsrfProtect
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

app = FastAPI()
oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="login")

@app.post("/team/{team_id}/change-role")
async def change_role(request: Request, team_id: str, csrf_protect: CsrfProtect = Depends()):
    user = request.session.get("user")
    if not user: raise HTTPException(401)
    await csrf_protect.validate_csrf(request)
    form = await request.form()
    target = form.get("username")
    new_role = form.get("role")
    set_user_role(team_id, target, new_role)
    return JSONResponse({"status": "success"})

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController
import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest
import javax.servlet.http.HttpSession

@RestController
fun handleExportData(@RequestParam userId: String, request: HttpServletRequest): String {
    val session = request.session
    val csrfToken = "TOKEN_" + System.currentTimeMillis()
    session.setAttribute("csrfToken", csrfToken)
    val submittedToken = request.getParameter("csrfToken")
    if (submittedToken == null || submittedToken != session.getAttribute("csrfToken"))
        return "Invalid CSRF token"
    triggerDataExport(userId)
    return "Export started for user $userId"
}

<?php
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\Routing\Annotation\Route;

#[Route('/admin/users', methods: ['POST'])]
public function createUser(Request $request): Response {
    $submittedToken = $request->request->get('csrf_token');
    $sessionToken = $request->getSession()->get('csrf_token');
    if (!$submittedToken || !hash_equals($sessionToken, $submittedToken)) {
        return new Response('CSRF token invalid', 403);
    }
    $username = $request->request->get('username');
    $role = $request->request->get('role');
    $this->userSvc->create($username, $role);
    return new Response('User created', 201);
}
